response.sql: WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT total_amount, 1.0 * total_amount / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM member_totals), compared AS (SELECT total_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS combined_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Income with a NULL link_to_member is excluded because it cannot be attributed to a member.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat NULL link_to_member as one group when calculating totals and shares.
